description:
Make the guard on gate-registry changes compare through the git module in the selected worktree, instead of probing and comparing in the process working directory.

## Background

- `enforce_main_only_operations` (`crates/jit/src/commands/worktree.rs:448-477`) skips in test mode, runs `git rev-parse --git-dir` in the process directory to decide whether git applies, and then calls `check_branch_divergence` (`crates/jit/src/commands/worktree.rs:388-420`), which also runs in the process directory and reads a failing merge base or a missing `origin/main` as "not diverged".
- The executor methods `add_gate_definition`, `define_gate`, `update_gate` and `remove_gate_definition` call it (`crates/jit/src/commands/gate.rs:1108`, `:1157`, `:1253`, `:1268`).
- Its unit tests `test_check_branch_divergence_on_main` (`crates/jit/src/commands/worktree.rs:1073-1081`) and `test_enforce_main_only_operations_when_diverged` (`crates/jit/src/commands/worktree.rs:1084-1087`) assert nothing.
- The module's base comparison returns `Compared`, `BaseUnresolved` or `NoMergeBase`.
- The two free functions become one executor method in the same change; keeping them beside it would leave two guard implementations (`@/inv/convention-convergence`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The guard is an executor method comparing through the module's base comparison of the executor's paths with base `origin/main`. It refuses only on a `Compared` outcome whose merge base differs from the base's commit, with today's message; without a git checkout, on `BaseUnresolved` and on `NoMergeBase` it allows the operation as today, and test mode still skips it.
- [hard] REQ-02: `check_branch_divergence`, `enforce_main_only_operations` and their two empty tests no longer exist, and neither `commands/worktree.rs` nor `commands/gate.rs` starts a git process for the guard.
- [hard] REQ-03: A CLI test runs `jit gate define` from a repository that matches its `origin/main`, with `JIT_DATA_DIR` selecting a repository whose branch diverged, and asserts the guard's refusal; today's code inspects the process directory and succeeds, so the test fails.

## Notes

- Whether the guard runs at all, and against which remote branch, is decided outside this change.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Main-history guard runs against the selected worktree
